verdict.rationale: Vapi's Composer feature lets users describe what they want to build in natural language and have Vapi handle the technical setup, and the official MCP server exposes assistant/call/phone-number management to any MCP-compatible AI assistant (e.g., Claude Desktop), enabling natural-language operation of the platform. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of Composer's natural-language reliability and richer documentation detail beyond a single line.
